messages:
anya: Hey team — Customer cannot reproduce UI action in Console: they get a 403 on POST /v1/deployments when clicking ‘Save’, intermittent. Asked for a HAR + console logs. Can we share a compact, cross-browser capture checklist they can follow? :mag:

support-bot: Thanks @anya, uploading tipdoc + secure upload link: https://support.redwood.com/upload (expires in 72h) :lock: Please ask them to put the case ID in the filename.

kenji: Short checklist I send:
1) Use Chrome (or Edge/Brave) stable.
2) Open DevTools (F12) -> Network tab. Check “Preserve log” and set throttling to "No throttling".
3) Click the small ⟳ to keep requests visible, then reproduce the failing flow.
4) Right-click network list -> Save all as HAR with content.
5) Console tab -> right-click -> Save as... or copy visible console text.

kenji: Include this curl repro (replace KEY with redacted key):
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/deployments" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"name":"test"}'
```
Ask them to run once after opening an Incognito window (extensions off). If they see a 403 here, paste the full response headers too.

olivia: Add these extras for us to triage faster:
- In DevTools -> Network, click a failing request and copy the value of the `x-request-id` (or `request-id`) header. Put that value in the upload note.
- If they can’t upload HAR, they can paste the network request as a cURL from DevTools: right-click request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL.

olivia: Quick jq snippet to pull request ids from a HAR (if they upload a big HAR):
```
jq -r '.log.entries[] | select(.response.status!=200) | .request.headers[]? | select(.name=="x-request-id" or .name=="request-id") | .value' file.har
```
Share that ID in the support upload so we can find it in our logs.

anya: Also ask user to try: open an Incognito/Private window, disable VPNs and adblocks, and attempt a repro. If works there, likely extension/CSP-related — note which extensions are enabled.

kenji: Mobile repro (different instructions):
- iOS Safari: Use a mac -> Safari -> Develop -> <device> -> inspect page -> Network + Console. Reproduce, then File -> Export -> Save Web Inspector Data.
- Android Chrome: Connect device -> chrome://inspect -> inspect -> Network tab -> reproduce -> right-click -> Save as HAR.
These are important because we’ve seen auth cookies and CORS vary on mobile.

support-bot: Remember: redact any long API keys or PII before upload. If they accidentally include tokens, tell them to replace with `REDACTED_KEY` in the file name and note. Upload link: https://support.redwood.com/upload (case: RW-12345)

olivia: Ask them to include: browser + exact version, OS, time of attempt (with timezone), and a short screenshot of the console error (red text + request row highlighted). That helps correlate with our logs.

anya: Perfect. I’ll DM the customer with the checklist, ask for an Incognito cURL capture and HAR, and collect the `x-request-id` if available. Will post the HAR link here once uploaded. :thumbsup:
